Court Considers Health Warnings at Liquor Shops

The Madras High Court is considering a public interest litigation seeking mandatory health warning boards in Tamil at TASMAC liquor shops. The court has asked the Tamil Nadu government to respond to the plea. The petitioner argues that such warnings are necessary to inform the public about the health risks associated with alcohol consumption. The case highlights a legal push for greater public health awareness regarding alcohol sales.
